title: From Fighting for His Life to a Forever Home: Laredo Shelter Puppy Morrison Finds His Family in Chicago
excerpt: Morrison came into Laredo Animal Care Services as a tiny newborn, half the size of his three siblings, fighting for his life. Foster care nursed him back to health — and now the little lab mix has found his forever home in Chicago.
content:
Morrison came into Laredo Animal Care Services as a tiny newborn, half the size of his three siblings, fighting for his life from the start. This week, the little lab mix has a forever home in Chicago — and a story the shelter is holding up as proof of what foster care can do.

Laredo Animal Care Services shared Morrison’s story in its “Rescue Stories” feature on Nov. 22. He arrived as a newborn with three siblings, so small and weak that his survival was uncertain. He was placed in foster care and nursed back to health with fluids and tender loving care, the shelter said.

The photos tell the rest: a pocket-sized puppy sleeping on blankets, warm and cozy, and then a larger, healthy dog sitting indoors in a blue collar. Morrison is now with his family in Chicago, through the rescue partner Mutts of the Midway, which lists him in Chicago.

For the shelter, Morrison is more than one happy ending. Laredo Animal Care Services used his story to put out a call for more foster heroes, saying dogs like Morrison need people willing to take in the smallest, weakest animals and give them the round-the-clock care that makes survival possible.

Anyone interested in fostering or adopting can reach Laredo Animal Care Services directly. Morrison went from a struggling pup to a beloved family member — and the shelter says there are more Morrisons waiting.
